#calc.

items.detail:
Calculates the absolute value of a numeric value.

```typ
#calc.abs(-5) \
#calc.abs(5pt - 2cm) \
#calc.abs(2fr) \
#calc.abs(decimal("-342.440"))
```
items.label: abs

items.detail:
Raises a value to some exponent.

```typ
#calc.pow(2, 3) \
#calc.pow(decimal("2.5"), 2)
```
items.label: pow

items.detail:
Raises a value to some exponent of $e$.

```typ
#calc.exp(1)
```
items.label: exp

items.detail:
Calculates the square root of a number.

```typ
#calc.sqrt(16) \
#calc.sqrt(2.5)
```
items.label: sqrt

items.detail:
Calculates the real $n$#super[th] root of a number.

If the number is negative, then $n$ must be odd.

```typ
#calc.root(16.0, 4) \
#calc.root(27.0, 3)
```
items.label: root

items.detail:
Calculates the sine of an angle.

When called with an integer or a float, they will be interpreted as radians.

```typ
#calc.sin(1.5) \
#calc.sin(90deg)
```
items.label: sin

items.detail:
Calculates the cosine of an angle.

When called with an integer or a float, they will be interpreted as radians.

```typ
#calc.cos(1.5) \
#calc.cos(90deg)
```
items.label: cos

items.detail:
Calculates the tangent of an angle.

When called with an integer or a float, they will be interpreted as radians.

```typ
#calc.tan(1.5) \
#calc.tan(90deg)
```
items.label: tan

items.detail:
Calculates the arcsine of a number.

```typ
#calc.asin(0) \
#calc.asin(1)
```
items.label: asin

items.detail:
Calculates the arccosine of a number.

```typ
#calc.acos(0) \
#calc.acos(1)
```
items.label: acos

items.detail:
Calculates the arctangent of a number.

```typ
#calc.atan(0) \
#calc.atan(1)
```
items.label: atan

items.detail:
Calculates the four-quadrant arctangent of a coordinate.

The four-quadrant arctangent of $(x, y)$ is defined as the argument of the
complex number $x + i y$.

Returns an @angle between `-180deg` and …
items.label: atan2

items.detail:
Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a hyperbolic angle.

The hyperbolic sine of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ (e^x - e^(-x)) / 2 $

```typ
#calc.sinh(0) \
#calc.sinh(1.5)
```
items.label: sinh

items.detail:
Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a hyperbolic angle.

The hyperbolic cosine of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ (e^x + e^(-x)) / 2 $

```typ
#calc.cosh(0) \
#calc.cosh(1.5)
```
items.label: cosh

items.detail:
Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a hyperbolic angle.

The hyperbolic tangent of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ (e^x - e^(-x)) / (e^x + e^(-x)) $

```typ
#calc.tanh(0) \
#calc.tanh(1.5)
```
items.label: tanh

items.detail:
Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.

The inverse hyperbolic sine of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ ln(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)) $

```typ
#calc.asinh(0) \
#calc.asinh(1)
```
items.label: asinh

items.detail:
Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number.

The inverse hyperbolic cosine of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ ln(x + sqrt(x^2 - 1)) $

```typ
#calc.acosh(1) \
#calc.acosh(2.5)
```
items.label: acosh

items.detail:
Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.

The inverse hyperbolic tangent of $x$ is defined as follows:
$ 1/2 ln((1 + x) / (1 - x)) $

```typ
#calc.atanh(0) \
#calc.atanh(0.5)
```
items.label: atanh

items.detail:
Calculates the logarithm of a number.

If the base is not specified, the logarithm is calculated in base ten.

```typ
#calc.log(100)
```
items.label: log

items.detail:
Calculates the natural logarithm of a number.

```typ
#calc.ln(calc.e)
```
items.label: ln

items.detail:
Applies the error function to a number.

The value of the error function at $x$ is defined as follows:
$ 2 / sqrt(pi) integral_0^x e^(-t^2) dif t $

```typ

```
items.label: erf

Calculates the factorial of a number.

items.label: fact

Calculates the greatest common divisor of two integers.

This will error if the result of integer division would be larger than the

Calculates the least common multiple of two integers.

```typ

```
